purpose: INT-207 full-process rehearsal on isolated MySQL: scenario to executed test mapping
harness: dedicated mysqld instances under /tmp/hzy-product-center.* and /tmp/hzy-test-mysql-*, loopback port, per-suite schemas; no shared or production database

scenarios.scenario: 改名立即可读 (authoritative rename visible immediately)
scenarios.notes: renamed master and category label are read through the authorized directory query in the same snapshot; the onboarding history snapshot stays frozen

scenarios.scenario: 部分产品线接入 (partial line onboarding)
scenarios.notes: already-managed and lifecycle-blocked products are skipped; only the selected products become modules; the line is no longer unifiable afterwards

scenarios.scenario: 需求→版本→确认/转交 (requirement to version to confirmation/handoff)
scenarios.notes: planning service runs over compatibility views with the enterprise identity; handoff paths exercised through HTTP

scenarios.test: internal/enterprise registry/scheduler transaction tests; productcenter concurrency suites
scenarios.notes: generation fencing and revision conflicts reject the losing writer

scenarios.scenario: 唯一归属冲突 (single ownership conflict)
scenarios.notes: line onboarding and individual onboarding of the same product race to exactly one success
same key and payload replays the frozen result; a different payload is rejected
committed prefix, copying checkpoint and trigger reinstall resume only the interrupted table, then guarded final recopy and activation

scenarios.scenario: 新旧命令重放 (old and new entry replay)
scenarios.notes: cross-entry replay with the same key returns the original receipt and keeps a single business row; a different payload conflicts

wholeSuite.raceRun: internal/enterprise, internal/server, aims and assets packages pass with -race

redaction: Only test names, counts and outcomes are recorded. No business rows, credentials or SQL parameters are stored.
